title: TaskFile af.task-file/1
$comment: JSON representation of the JSON/TOML CLI Task file. Admission additionally checks encoded byte bounds, sorted Jira fields, captured source/package existence, kind/profile compatibility and joint resource feasibility. Omitted options use their Rust defaults; explicit null is invalid. wall_ms is an input duration, optionally capped by command-line policy before the absolute deadline is validated. wall_ms starts at the first `af task run`, not at planning. Omitted `schema` reads as af.task-file/1. Omitted `limits` and `pipeline` come from `[task.defaults]` of the Authority Snapshot's `.af/af.toml`, and a Task file without `limits` is refused when the project declares none. `continue` plans the Task from a finished Task's reviewed candidate and hands its implementer that round's findings; `context` names files the Worker reads first, bound by digest (ADR-0206).

schema.description: Omitted, the file is read as af.task-file/1.

context.description: Files of the Task's source tree the Worker reads before the goal: each a repository path with an optional `#section` anchor, captured by its content digest into an af/TaskReadFirst@1 record and listed at the end of the Worker's requirements, after the project's `.af/rules.md`. A changed file is a changed plan.

continue.description: Continue a finished Task of the same Store from its reviewed candidate: the candidate Snapshot of the named review round (the last when `round` is omitted) is this Task's source, and that round's reviewer reports and the evaluator's verdict are one af/TaskReviewFindings@1 artifact on the selected Pipeline's optional `findings` input. `af task run NEW --from TASK` writes this table. It excludes `inputs.source` and `inputs.findings`.

base.description: The commit whose tree the Task's judging Workers (reviewers, evaluators, verifiers) read read-only at `../base`, beside `../diff-subject.json` (af/diff-subject@1). Captured at plan time as an af/TaskBase@1 record. Absent, the source Snapshot's recorded base: a sealed candidate's parent, or the parent of a bound tree. Excludes `continue`.

inputs.$comment: Optional root input bindings (ADR-0117, widened by ADR-0134). Absent by default; a Task file written before this decision compiles to the identical revision. Any root input the selected Pipeline declares may be bound except requirements, base and continuation; those and every undeclared name are refused by name at plan time, not here, so the refusal can say which Task and port asked for them. An exact artifact binds only source, history and sources; a list of Task outputs binds only a `many` port.

oneOf.$comment: Several recorded Task outputs gathered, in this order, into one `many` port (ADR-0134).

strategy.description: Absent, the Task's kind fills it in, with `verification` and `facts.standard` unless the file names them: `implement` is `reviewed` with `verification` `review`, `verification` is `light` with `evaluation`, both with `facts.standard = true`, and `report` is `report`. A kind without a default needs `strategy`.
